parole.significato: Sauvignon blanc; a green-skinned French wine grape cultivar used chiefly in the production of white wine
parole.testo: Unadapted borrowing from French sauvignon blanc (“Sauvignon blanc”), literally “white sauvignon”. The origin of French sauvignon is uncertain; it has variously been connected with other regional grape names and, tentatively, with sauvage (“wild”).
